name: @agentek/mcp-server

tools.name: resolveENS

tools.name: lookupENS
tools.description: Looks up the ENS name for an Ethereum address

tools.name: getAllowance
tools.description: Gets the ERC20 token allowance between an owner and spender

chainId.description: If not specified, returns approval for all supported chains.

tools.name: getBalanceOf
tools.description: Gets the ERC20 token balance of an address

chainId.description: If not specified, returns balance for all supported chains.

tools.name: getTotalSupply
tools.description: Gets the total supply of an ERC20 token

chainId.description: If not specified, returns total supply for all supported chains.

tools.name: getDecimals
tools.description: Gets the number of decimals of an ERC20 token

chainId.description: If not specified, returns decimals for all supported chains.

tools.name: getName
tools.description: Gets the name of an ERC20 token

chainId.description: If not specified, returns name for all supported chains.

tools.name: getSymbol
tools.description: Gets the symbol of an ERC20 token

chainId.description: If not specified, returns symbol for all supported chains.

tools.name: getTokenMetadata
tools.description: Gets all metadata (name, symbol, decimals, totalSupply) of an ERC20 token

chainId.description: The token chain

tools.name: intentApprove
tools.description: Creates an intent to approve token spending. Supports "max" for unlimited approval.

amount.description: The amount to approve. Use "max" for unlimited approval (type(uint256).max)

chainId.description: Optional specific chain to use

tools.name: getAcrossFeeQuote
tools.description: Fetches a suggested fee quote for a cross-chain asset bridge using the Across Protocol REST API.

inputToken.description: The token contract address on the origin chain (e.g., WETH address).

outputToken.description: The token contract address on the destination chain (e.g., corresponding WETH address).

originChainId.description: Chain ID where the input token exists.

destinationChainId.description: Chain ID of the destination chain.

amount.description: Amount of tokens to bridge in human-readable units (e.g. '1.5' for 1.5 tokens). Decimals are resolved automatically from the token contract.

recipient.description: Recipient address on the destination chain.

tools.name: intentDepositAcross
tools.description: Bridge ERC20 tokens cross-chain via Across Protocol. Automatically handles token approval and fetches optimal relay fees. Does not support native ETH.

originChainId.description: Chain ID of the origin chain for the deposit.

originToken.description: Address of the token to bridge on the origin chain.

amount.description: Amount of tokens to bridge in human-readable units (e.g. '1.5' for 1.5 tokens). Decimals are resolved automatically from the token contract.

destinationToken.description: Address of the token to bridge on the destination chain.

destinationChainId.description: Chain ID of the destination chain for the transfer.

recipient.description: Recipient address on the destination chain.

tools.name: intentTransfer
tools.description: Transfer ERC20 tokens or native ETH to an address or ENS name. Supports ENS resolution, automatic decimal handling, and auto-selects the cheapest chain if chainId is omitted.

token.description: The token contract address (0x...), or 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 for native ETH

amount.description: Amount to transfer in human-readable units (e.g. '1.5' for 1.5 tokens). Decimals are resolved automatically.

to.description: Recipient address (0x...) or ENS name (e.g. 'vitalik.eth'). ENS names are resolved automatically.

chainId.description: Chain ID to transfer on (e.g. 1, 42161, 8453). If omitted, automatically selects the cheapest chain where you have sufficient balance.

tools.name: intentTransferFrom
tools.description: Transfer ERC20 tokens from another address using transferFrom. Requires prior ERC20 approval from the 'from' address. Does not support native ETH. Supports ENS resolution and auto-selects the cheapest chain if chainId is omitted.

token.description: The ERC20 token contract address (0x...). Does not support native ETH.

amount.description: Amount to transfer in human-readable units (e.g. '1.5' for 1.5 tokens). Decimals are resolved automatically.

from.description: The address to transfer tokens from (0x...). Must have approved your address via ERC20 approve first.

to.description: Recipient address (0x...) or ENS name (e.g. 'vitalik.eth'). ENS names are resolved automatically.

chainId.description: Chain ID to transfer on (e.g. 1, 42161, 8453). If omitted, automatically selects the cheapest chain where the 'from' address has sufficient balance.

tools.name: getLatestTokens
tools.description: Get trending tokens from Dexscreener with market data including USD price, 24h volume, and 24h price change. Filters by the specified chain.

chainId.description: Chain ID to fetch trending tokens for (1 for Ethereum, 8453 for Base)

tools.name: getBalance
tools.description: Get the native token (ETH) balance for an address. If chainId is omitted, returns balances across all supported chains.

chainId.description: Chain ID to query (e.g. 1 for Ethereum, 8453 for Base). Omit to query all supported chains.

formatEth.description: If true, returns balance formatted in ETH instead of wei

tools.name: getCode
tools.description: Get the deployed bytecode at an address. Returns empty if the address is an EOA (not a contract). If chainId is omitted, queries all supported chains.

chainId.description: Chain ID to query. Omit to query all supported chains.

tools.name: getTransactionCount
tools.description: Get the nonce (number of transactions sent) from an address. If chainId is omitted, returns counts across all supported chains.

chainId.description: Chain ID to query. Omit to query all supported chains.

tools.name: getBlock
tools.description: Get information about a block including timestamp, transactions, gas used, etc. Returns the latest block if no block number is specified.

blockNumber.description: The block number to fetch. Omit to get the latest block.

chainId.description: Chain ID to query (e.g. 1 for Ethereum, 8453 for Base)

tools.name: getBlockNumber
tools.description: Get the current (latest) block number. If chainId is omitted, returns block numbers for all supported chains.

chainId.description: Chain ID to query. Omit to query all supported chains.

tools.name: getGasPrice
tools.description: Get the current gas price. If chainId is not specified, returns gas prices for all supported chains.

chainId.description: Chain ID to query. Omit to query all supported chains.

formatGwei.description: If true, returns gas price formatted in gwei instead of wei

tools.name: estimateGas
tools.description: Estimate the gas required for a transaction. If chainId is omitted, estimates on all supported chains.

value.description: ETH value to send in ether (e.g. '0.1' for 0.1 ETH)

chainId.description: Chain ID to estimate on. Omit to estimate on all supported chains.

tools.name: getFeeHistory
tools.description: Get historical gas fee info

blockCount.description: Number of blocks in the requested range. Between 1 and 1024 blocks can be requested in a single query. Less than requested may be returned if not all blocks are available.

rewardPercentiles.description: A monotonically increasing list of percentile values to sample from each block's effective priority fees per gas in ascending order, weighted by gas used.

tools.name: getTransaction
tools.description: Get details about a transaction including sender, recipient, value, gas, and input data.

chainId.description: Chain ID where the transaction was sent

tools.name: getTransactionReceipt
tools.description: Get the receipt of a mined transaction including status, gas used, and logs.

chainId.description: Chain ID where the transaction was mined

tools.name: intentSendTransaction
tools.description: Send an arbitrary transaction to any address. Specify a human-readable ABI signature with function name and arguments to encode calldata automatically, or provide raw hex data. Use this for any contract interaction not covered by other tools.

to.description: The target contract or recipient address

value.description: ETH value to send in ether (e.g. '0.1' for 0.1 ETH)

abi.description: Human-readable ABI signatures for the function to call, e.g. ['function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) returns (bool)']

functionName.description: The function name to call, e.g. 'transfer'

args.description: The arguments to pass to the function, e.g. ['0x1234...', '1000000000000000000']

data.description: Raw hex calldata. Use this only if abi/functionName/args are not provided.

chainId.description: Chain ID to send the transaction on

tools.name: getUniV3Pool
tools.description: Gets the current state of a Uniswap V3 pool including sqrtPriceX96, current tick, and whether the pool is unlocked.

poolAddress.description: The Uniswap V3 pool contract address (0x...)

chainId.description: Chain ID where the pool is deployed (e.g. 1, 8453, 42161)

tools.name: getUserPositions
tools.description: Gets all Uniswap V3 LP positions owned by a user. Defaults to the connected wallet if no user address is provided.

chainId.description: Chain ID to query (e.g. 1, 8453, 42161)

user.description: The wallet address to check. Omit to use the connected wallet.

tools.name: getPoolFeeData
tools.description: Gets fee growth globals and protocol fee data for a Uniswap V3 pool.

poolAddress.description: The Uniswap V3 pool contract address (0x...)

chainId.description: Chain ID where the pool is deployed (e.g. 1, 8453, 42161)

tools.name: getPositionDetails
tools.description: Gets detailed information about a specific Uniswap V3 LP position including token pair, fee tier, tick range, liquidity, and owed fees.

tokenId.description: The NFT token ID of the LP position

chainId.description: Chain ID where the position exists (e.g. 1, 8453, 42161)

tools.name: intentMintPosition
tools.description: Creates a new Uniswap V3 liquidity position by minting an LP NFT. Requires both tokens to be approved for the Position Manager contract beforehand.

token0.description: Address of the first token in the pair (0x...). Must be the lower-sorted address.

token1.description: Address of the second token in the pair (0x...). Must be the higher-sorted address.

fee.description: Pool fee tier in hundredths of a bip (e.g. 500 for 0.05%, 3000 for 0.3%, 10000 for 1%)

tickLower.description: Lower tick boundary of the position's price range

tickUpper.description: Upper tick boundary of the position's price range

amount0Desired.description: Desired amount of token0 to deposit in wei as a decimal string

amount1Desired.description: Desired amount of token1 to deposit in wei as a decimal string

slippageTolerance.description: Max slippage as a percentage (e.g. 0.5 for 0.5%). Default: 0.5

recipient.description: Address to receive the LP NFT (0x...). Defaults to the connected wallet.

deadline.description: Unix timestamp deadline for the transaction. Defaults to 20 minutes from now.

chainId.description: Chain ID where the pool exists (e.g. 1, 8453, 42161)

tools.name: intentIncreaseLiquidity
tools.description: Adds more liquidity to an existing Uniswap V3 LP position identified by its NFT token ID.

tokenId.description: The NFT token ID of the existing LP position

amount0Desired.description: Desired amount of token0 to add in wei as a decimal string

amount1Desired.description: Desired amount of token1 to add in wei as a decimal string

slippageTolerance.description: Max slippage as a percentage (e.g. 0.5 for 0.5%). Default: 0.5

deadline.description: Unix timestamp deadline for the transaction. Defaults to 20 minutes from now.

chainId.description: Chain ID where the position exists (e.g. 1, 8453, 42161)

tools.name: intentDecreaseLiquidity
tools.description: Removes liquidity from a Uniswap V3 LP position. The removed tokens are not automatically collected — use intentCollectFees afterwards to withdraw them.

tokenId.description: The NFT token ID of the LP position to remove liquidity from

liquidity.description: Amount of liquidity to remove as a decimal string (get this from getPositionDetails)

slippageTolerance.description: Max slippage as a percentage (e.g. 0.5 for 0.5%). Default: 0.5

deadline.description: Unix timestamp deadline for the transaction. Defaults to 20 minutes from now.

chainId.description: Chain ID where the position exists (e.g. 1, 8453, 42161)

tools.name: intentCollectFees
tools.description: Collects all accumulated trading fees and any tokens from decreased liquidity for a Uniswap V3 LP position.

tokenId.description: The NFT token ID of the LP position to collect fees from

recipient.description: Address to receive the collected tokens (0x...). Defaults to the connected wallet.

chainId.description: Chain ID where the position exists (e.g. 1, 8453, 42161)

tools.name: intentTransferPosition
tools.description: Transfers ownership of a Uniswap V3 LP NFT to another address using safeTransferFrom.

tokenId.description: The NFT token ID of the LP position to transfer

to.description: The recipient address to transfer the LP NFT to (0x...)

chainId.description: Chain ID where the position exists (e.g. 1, 8453, 42161)

tools.name: depositWETH
tools.description: Wrap native ETH into WETH (Wrapped ETH) by depositing into the WETH contract. You receive an equal amount of WETH, an ERC20 token.

chainId.description: Chain ID to deposit on (e.g. 1 for Ethereum, 8453 for Base, 42161 for Arbitrum)

amount.description: Amount of ETH to wrap in human-readable units (e.g. '1.5' for 1.5 ETH)

tools.name: withdrawWETH
tools.description: Unwrap WETH back to native ETH by withdrawing from the WETH contract. Burns your WETH and returns an equal amount of native ETH.

chainId.description: Chain ID to withdraw on (e.g. 1 for Ethereum, 8453 for Base, 42161 for Arbitrum)

amount.description: Amount of WETH to unwrap in human-readable units (e.g. '1.5' for 1.5 WETH)
